data.one_liner: A common platform interface for the FlutterMidiCommand plugin.
data.what_it_does: Defines shared platform contracts, optional BLE transport contracts, and shared models like MidiDevice and MidiPacket for the flutter_midi_command plugin ecosystem.
use_when: Building or extending a federated platform plugin implementation for flutter_midi_command.
avoid_when: Building a standard app that only needs to send and receive MIDI data, as you should use the main package instead.
strengths: Provides a standardized interface for native MIDI and optional BLE transport contracts.
Ensures cross-platform consistency for federated plugin developers.
weaknesses: Not intended for direct app-facing use without the corresponding main plugin.
Requires platform implementers to handle interface updates carefully.
